```{r}
data_dir <- "~/Research_2026/STTT_letter/STTT_Letter_Revision/"

RA_ranking <- read.csv(paste0(data_dir, "RNA_ATAC_3score_comparison.csv"))
MultiVI_ranking <- read.csv("~/Research_2025/Gladstone/MultiVI/MultiVI_output/MultiVI_3score_comparison_scVIsingle.csv")
MOFA_ranking <- read.csv(paste0(data_dir, "MOFA_3score_comparison.csv"))
```



```{r}
NK_signal = c("PTPRC", "HLA-DMB", "HLA-DMA", "HLA-DPB1", "HLA-G")
CD8_signal = c("SLFN11", "AIM2", "CCR7", "IFITM1", "CD7", "MX1", "TIGIT", "MX2", "CD38", "IFIT3", "CXCR5", "BRD4", "CD14", "CD69", "MAPK14", "HNRNPD", "HNRNPH1", "YBX1", "FOS", "SYNCRIP", "NFATC3", "RARA", "ITK", "NR3C1", "DDX5", "NPM1", "SLA2", "CD4")
CD8_RT = c("CD4", "MX1", "MX2", "IFIT3", "SLFN11", "IFITM1", "BRD4", "AIM2")
```



```{r}
PID = c(9, 12)

Sender = "NK"
Receiver = "CD8_T"

df.list.NK = list()
df.list.CD8 = list()

for (i in 1:2) {
  
  # for method 1
  df = RA_ranking
  df$rank_combined = pmin(df$rank_rna, df$rank_atac)
  df_PID = df[df$PID == PID[i], ]
  df.Sender = df_PID[df_PID$cell_type == Sender & df_PID$gene %in% NK_signal,  ]
  df.Receiver = df_PID[df_PID$cell_type == Receiver & df_PID$gene %in% CD8_RT , ]
  
  RA.Sender = df.Sender
  RA.Sender$method = "RNA/ATAC"
  RA.Receiver = df.Receiver
  RA.Receiver$method = "RNA/ATAC"
  
  # for multivi
  df = MultiVI_ranking
  df_PID = df[df$PID == PID[i], ]
  df.Sender = df_PID[df_PID$cell_type == Sender & df_PID$gene %in% NK_signal, ]
  df.Receiver = df_PID[df_PID$cell_type == Receiver & df_PID$gene %in% CD8_RT , ]
  
  MultiVI.Sender = df.Sender
  MultiVI.Sender$method = "MultiVI"
  MultiVI.Receiver = df.Receiver
  MultiVI.Receiver$method = "MultiVI"
  
  # for MOFA
  df = MOFA_ranking
  df_PID = df[df$PID == PID[i], ]
  df.Sender = df_PID[df_PID$cell_type == Sender & df_PID$gene %in% NK_signal,  ]
  df.Receiver = df_PID[df_PID$cell_type == Receiver & df_PID$gene %in% CD8_RT ,  ]
  
  MOFA.Sender = df.Sender
  MOFA.Sender$method = "MOFA"
  MOFA.Receiver = df.Receiver
  MOFA.Receiver$method = "MOFA"
  
  df.NK <- rbind(RA.Sender, MultiVI.Sender, MOFA.Sender)
  df.NK$PID = PID[i]
  df.list.NK[[i]] = df.NK
  
  df.CD8 <- rbind(RA.Receiver, MultiVI.Receiver, MOFA.Receiver)
  df.CD8$PID = PID[i]
  df.list.CD8[[i]] = df.CD8
  
}

```


```{r}
df <- rbindlist(df.list.CD8)

df2.list = list()

df2.list[[1]] = df[ df$method == "RNA/ATAC" , c("gene", "rank_combined", "cell_type", "PID", "method") ]
df2.list[[1]]$score_type = "Incytr"

df2.list[[2]] = df[ df$method == "MultiVI" , c("gene", "rank_rna", "cell_type", "PID", "method") ]
df2.list[[2]]$score_type = "RNA"
df2.list[[3]] = df[ df$method == "MultiVI" , c("gene", "rank_atac", "cell_type", "PID", "method") ]
df2.list[[3]]$score_type = "ATAC"
df2.list[[4]] = df[ df$method == "MultiVI" , c("gene", "rank_combined", "cell_type", "PID", "method") ]
df2.list[[4]]$score_type = "Combined"

df2.list[[5]] = df[ df$method == "MOFA" , c("gene", "rank_rna", "cell_type", "PID", "method") ]
df2.list[[5]]$score_type = "RNA"
df2.list[[6]] = df[ df$method == "MOFA" , c("gene", "rank_atac", "cell_type", "PID", "method") ]
df2.list[[6]]$score_type = "ATAC"
df2.list[[7]] = df[ df$method == "MOFA" , c("gene", "rank_combined", "cell_type", "PID", "method") ]
df2.list[[7]]$score_type = "Combined"

for (i in 1:length(df2.list)) {
  colnames(df2.list[[i]])[2] = "value"
}

df = rbindlist(df2.list)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

n_total <- 33258
pct <- function(rank) (n_total - rank + 1) / n_total * 100
threshold_pct <- pct(10000)

gene_order <- c("CD4", "MX1", "MX2", "IFIT3", "SLFN11", "IFITM1", "BRD4", "AIM2")

df <- df %>% # read.csv("Ranking_plot.csv") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    value      = pct(value),
    gene       = factor(gene, levels = gene_order),
    method     = recode(method, "RNA/ATAC" = "Incytr"),
    method     = factor(method, levels = c("Incytr", "MultiVI", "MOFA")),
    fill_state = ifelse(score_type %in% c("Incytr", "Combined"), "Combined", "Single modality"),
    pid_shape_key = factor(
      paste0("PID ", PID, " - ", fill_state),
      levels = c("PID 9 - Combined", "PID 9 - Single modality", "PID 12 - Combined", "PID 12 - Single modality")
    ),
    score_type = factor(score_type, levels = c("Incytr", "RNA", "ATAC", "Combined"))
  ) %>%
  # order within each gene: Incytr(2) -> MultiVI Combined(2) -> MultiVI RNA/ATAC(4) -> MOFA Combined(2) -> MOFA RNA/ATAC(4)
  arrange(gene, method, desc(fill_state == "Filled"), PID, score_type) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x_pos_local = row_number()) %>%   # 1..14 per gene
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x_pos = (as.integer(gene) - 1) * 14 + x_pos_local)

n_genes <- length(gene_order)
group_width <- 14

x_breaks    <- (seq_len(n_genes) - 1) * group_width + (group_width + 1) / 2
group_lines <- c(0.5, (seq_len(n_genes - 1)) * group_width + 0.5, n_genes * group_width + 0.5)

method_colors <- c("Incytr" = "#2a78d6", "MultiVI" = "#eb6834", "MOFA" = "#1baf7a")
pid_shapes <- c(
  "PID 9 - Combined"    = 16,  # filled circle
  "PID 9 - Single modality"  = 1,   # open circle
  "PID 12 - Combined"   = 17,  # filled triangle
  "PID 12 - Single modality" = 2    # open triangle
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = x_pos, y = value, color = method, shape = pid_shape_key)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = group_lines, color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = threshold_pct, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 5, stroke = 1.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = pid_shapes) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = x_breaks, labels = gene_order,
    limits = c(0.5, n_genes * group_width + 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Gene", y = "Percentile rank", color = "Method", shape = "PID / fill") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line = element_line(color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4)
  )

ggsave("CD8_ranking_3.pdf", width = 10, height = 4, units = "in")
```
